lead.headline: Reliant Care's 30 Missouri nursing homes log 35% fewer nurse hours and 3.8x the harm citations per bed
lead.number: 2.16 vs 3.35 nurse hours per resident per day against other Missouri for-profit homes; 4.67 vs 1.23 harm citations per 100 beds (3.8x); fines $117,358 vs $27,138 per 100 beds (4.3x)
lead.watch_out: Those 4 worst-list homes hold 76 of 141 harm citations; without them harm and fines are 2.5x, not 3.8x/4.3x. And it's 30 homes, not 31.

Staffing varies widely by facility in the state. Two dozen facilities offer less than 2 hours of daily nursing care per resident. The for-profit Reliant Care owns several of the largest facilities in Missouri. Sixteen of the entities associated with Reliant Care offer less than 2 hours of daily individual nursing care, according to the latest data. One, North Village Park, offers just 37 minutes per day of care, the federal data shows.
